props.gloss_en: the thigh-bone of a corpse: one who touches it, whether sealed or perforated, is impure
the thigh-bone of consecrated [animals]: one who touches it, whether sealed or perforated, is impure
the thigh-bone of a carcass: one who touches it sealed is pure
the thigh-bone of a creeping animal: one who touches it sealed is pure
the thigh-bone of a carcass perforated to any extent imparts impurity by contact
the thigh-bone of a creeping animal perforated to any extent imparts impurity by contact
the sealed thigh-bone of a carcass, which does not come into the category of contact, does not come into the category of carrying
the perforated thigh-bone of a carcass, which comes into the category of contact, comes into the category of carrying

the verse says 'one who touches ... and one who carries' (Lev 11:39-40): what comes into the category of contact comes into the category of carrying; what does not come into the category of contact does not come into the category of carrying
